summary: docs(diagrams): sync architecture + fitting-workflow diagrams with current impl

Corrected fitting_workflow.md L2 gate label from all-modes to individual-per-angle-mode-only, matching anti_degeneracy_controller.py gating table

graphify graph.json rebuild refused by shrink-guard (9631 vs 9949 nodes) because 15 unrelated docs predate extraction-prompt fingerprinting; left untouched rather than forcing an overwrite, deferred to a future full rebuild

summary: docs(diagrams): add print-ready fitting workflow figure (PNG/PDF)
decisions: Restructured fitting_workflow.md's mermaid diagram to a vertical (TB) pipeline instead of the landscape band layout, since a landscape figure shrinks unreadably when scaled to a 3.375in single journal column
Used invisible rank-forcing links (~~~) to stagger the 5 strategy-path boxes into a single file instead of a wide sibling row, keeping the figure narrow

Pinned the anti-degeneracy subgraph to explicit 'direction LR' — mermaid subgraphs silently default direction based on surrounding edge structure, and it flipped to vertical stacking twice during iteration without an explicit pin

Removed the subgraph's inline title text (it overlapped the box border/converging arrows once fontSize was raised for print) and replaced it with a separate borderless caption node forced above the box via an invisible link
Set flowchart.wrappingWidth high enough that node labels render on one line instead of auto-wrapping, then let node width grow to fit
bugs: Landscape diagram (10.5in wide) did not fit a single journal column; fixed by rebuilding as a narrow vertical pipeline scaled to 3.375in @300dpi
Anti-degeneracy subgraph title text visually collided with the box border and incoming arrows at the larger print font size; fixed by moving the caption to its own node outside the subgraph

summary: fix(optimization): skip heterodyne baseline solve that would OOM
decisions: Reused the existing select_nlsq_strategy() memory estimator (already used by the hybrid-streaming dispatch gate) instead of inventing a new heuristic, called with the true joint parameter count (n_scaling + n_physics) rather than the physical-only count the upstream gate uses

Skip condition requires BOTH an unsafe memory estimate AND the Layer-2 hierarchical escape being configured to pick up the fit afterward -- if hierarchical is not enabled, the baseline solve still runs and fails honestly rather than silently skipping with no fallback

Reused build_failed_result() to construct the skipped-fit placeholder so it is byte-identical in shape to what the OOM path already produced (parameters=initial_params), avoiding any change to downstream numerics on the already-covered failure path
bugs: Heterodyne per_angle_mode=individual at >=1M points (23 angles -> 60 joint params, 23M points) tried to allocate a 114GB dense Jacobian for the stratified-LS baseline solve against a 41.6GB budget, because no gate checked the true joint parameter count (upstream dispatch only counted physical params) before calling adapter.fit()
